scope: 21 S&P large caps added beside the 11 original companies: XBRL for the latest eight fiscal quarters plus the year-ago year, and 8-K earnings-release tables for up to eight paired quarters, behind a new XBRL gate
approved_by_owner: expansion to about 35 companies; spend cap lifted (dry-run first, ledger budget at the estimate plus margin); MAX_BYTES raised to 16 MiB in a separate commit
commands: fetch Submissions + companyfacts and dry-build each candidate (receipts.ingest.build_company, no writes)
.venv/bin/python -m receipts.press_release --tickers <the 21> --quarters 8 --validate --offline --validation-out <scratch>   # the XBRL gate over all eight quarters, from cache
command_notes: SEC_USER_AGENT was supplied in each command's environment; its value is not recorded.
--validate rewrites data/pr_facts/_validation.json; it was restored byte for byte after each run, and the final run wrote its report elsewhere with the new --validation-out flag.
Ingest window on 2026-10-31: facts ending since 2023-09-14, filings since 2023-05-17 (--quarters 8).

AVGO.name: Broadcom Inc.
AVGO.note: net income is tagged only as ProfitLoss with no noncontrolling interest: 0/8 under the old mapping, 8/8 with the guarded ProfitLoss fallback

dropped.V: diluted EPS 0/8: Visa reports EPS only per share class (dimensional XBRL), so companyfacts has no company-level diluted EPS
dropped.MA: net income 0/8: Mastercard tags only ProfitLoss, which includes noncontrolling interests (0.11-0.18% of it), and NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest; the guarded fallback refuses it, so no exact company net income exists in companyfacts
dropped.XOM: 1/8 for revenue, net income and diluted EPS: ticker XOM now resolves to ExxonMobil Holdings Corp (CIK 2115436), a new registrant with one 10-Q (Q2 2026); earlier quarters are under Exxon Mobil Corp (CIK 34088), and ingest maps one ticker to one CIK

runs.run: eight quarters with the XBRL gate (--offline)

model.budget_note: --budget-usd caps the cumulative ledger: set to the ledger plus about twice the dry-run estimate

receipts/store.py: ALIASES for the 21 kept companies (no 'Coke': COKE is Coca-Cola Consolidated)
net_income maps NetIncomeLoss, then ProfitLoss (guarded in ingest)
receipts/ingest.py: ProfitLoss stands in for net income only where the same filing reports no nonzero noncontrolling interest for that period
receipts/press_release.py: XBRL gate (xbrl_gate, apply_xbrl_gate): drop served GAAP facts the paired or latest 10-Q/10-K contradicts unless a documented restatement; quarantine a whole file on a column swap or 2+ unexplained mismatches in one period column
quarantined files are written as <accession>.jsonl.quarantined, never loaded
--no-xbrl-gate (diagnostics) and --validation-out flags; fallback concepts kept in step with receipts.store
receipts/verify.py: the peer search never names another company from a canonical percentage metric (gross margin, tax rate, revenue growth)
code_changes.proof_existing_companies_unaffected: all 11 existing companies dry-build to identical rows under the new ingest code; the gate finds nothing in all 83 pre-existing release files

tests/test_press_release.py: new: 6 XBRL gate tests (drop, restatement kept, same-column quarantine, column-swap quarantine, unserved mismatch kept, quarantined file never read)
tests/test_verify.py: new: test_a_gross_margin_equal_to_another_companys_never_names_it (fails on HEAD's verifier, passes now)
tests/test_handoff_a.py: test_real_apple_month_period_and_lookahead: the uncovered-company example changed from IBM (now covered) to Visa and 'covers 11 companies' to 'covers 32 companies' (company-count pin)

notes: ORCL Q1 FY2027 is ?: its latest 10-Q repeats last year's DEI label (Q1 FY2026), so ingest keeps the earlier filing's label and the quarter has no fiscal label
KO with the company's own line item 'net operating revenues' is ?: the qualifier rule reads 'operating' as a basis it can't match; 'revenue' or 'net revenues' verify

limitations: ORCL's newest quarter (ended 2026-08-31) and CRM's Q4 FY2026 carry no fiscal label: their companyfacts DEI labels repeat the prior year's, and ingest keeps the earlier filing's label by design. Claims there return ?.
UNH's three latest releases and one older release each of NKE, LLY and GS have no parseable HTML tables: XBRL only.
Disney's releases print costs in parentheses and report net income including noncontrolling interests: 7 of 8 files are quarantined, so Disney is close to XBRL-only.
Several companies' latest paired quarter is June 2026 because their September 10-Q isn't filed yet.
Visa, Mastercard and Exxon Mobil are not covered (see dropped).
Press-release facts are Muse Spark table maps that code re-parses and the XBRL gate checks; segment and non-GAAP figures have no XBRL counterpart.
